deploy-bot: Deploy started for v2.14.0 -> canary cluster-canary-3. Rollout ID rlt-2026-03-20-01. Canary: 50rps for 10m. :rocket:
anna: starting watch. I have health checks running on smoke and txn tests.
mike: getting alerts — 5xx rate up to 4.2% on /generate, latency p90 jumped to 1.2s (baseline 350ms). :warning:
priya: seeing OOM churn on canary-nodes-7, kube evictions 2m ago.
tom: logs show repeated kv cache misses and a spike in GPU mem alloc fail traces. attaching snippet:```ERROR runtime: failed to allocate kv-cache slice: out of memory```
emma: is this affecting user-facing traffic or only canary?
anna: only canary so far but SLA alert triggered due to error budget threshold.
jordan: ok — let's consult the backout runbook. link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/unpin-and-backout (internal) :eyes:
priya: from runbook quick steps: 1) pin traffic to previous stable model/release 2) scale down canary pool 3) revert routing config 4) create incident ticket.
mike: ready to execute if we decide. recommend unpin now to limit errors.
tom: propose these commands (from runbook):
```
# pin back to stable
redwood route set --service inference-api --version v2.13.7 --weight 100
# scale down canary
kubectl scale deployment canary-inference --replicas=0 -n inference-canary
# revert infra changes
redwood infra apply --rollback rlt-2026-03-20-01
```
anna: calling it — backout approved. Jordan + Emma ack?
jordan: ack. do it.
emma: ack, notify PM oncall afterward.
priya: executing pin now.
priya: `redwood route set --service inference-api --version v2.13.7 --weight 100` -> DONE. :white_check_mark:
mike: seeing drop in 5xxs to 0.4% within 45s. latency trending down. :thumbsup:
tom: scaling canary down now. `kubectl scale deployment canary-inference --replicas=0 -n inference-canary` -> DONE.
priya: reverted infra rollout: `redwood infra apply --rollback rlt-2026-03-20-01` -> started, resources reconciling.
anna: creating incident ticket and linking runbook: INC-2026-1034 /postmortem planned.
emma: scheduling a postmortem with PM + eng for tomorrow 10am PT.
jordan: quick notes for postmortem: root cause hypothesis = mem pressure from model kv-cache increase due to new quantization code path. capture traces and reproducer.
tom: saving logs and snapshots to /mnt/retention/canary-2026-03-20-01.
mike: oncall handoff in 30m, but system looks stable. keeping watch.
priya: canary nodes terminated cleanly. no ongoing evictions.
anna: thanks everyone. runbook executed per steps, incident created. next steps: attach perf traces to INC-2026-1034, include exact commands used, and list follow-ups (hotfix, rollback automation checklist).
jordan: also add a short gate to canary run: monitor GPU mem and kv-cache miss ratio, block if beyond threshold.
emma: agreed — will add to release checklist and require a smoke test that exercises kv-cache.
mike: closing thread when postmortem created.
deploy-bot: Rollout rlt-2026-03-20-01 marked aborted by anna at 1934567942. Events: traffic pinned, canary scaled down, infra rollback initiated.
anna: closing — all done from release side. thanks :clap:
